ideas.pitch: An AI-powered automated patching and circuit analysis agent designed to protect solutions from losing points during the Team vs Team survival face-offs.
ideas.problem_statement: PITCH//BREAK: THE SURVIVAL ARENA Build under pressure. Bid for power. Adapt to the unexpected. Then defend your solution.
ideas.title: ArenaPatch: Automated Code Vulnerability & Fault Patching Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the survival mechanic of the event where faults and failures cost points during head-to-head defenses, leveraging automated repair logic similar to winning agent architectures.

ideas.pitch: A rapid-adaptation developer tool that allows teams to inject new features, pivot codebases, and re-theme UIs on the fly when unexpected arena challenges drop.
ideas.problem_statement: PITCH//BREAK: THE SURVIVAL ARENA Round 3: Challenge — Adapt your solution to a new challenge. Show the judges how well your team can think on its feet.
ideas.title: AdaptFlow: Real-time Feature Injection & Dynamic UI Refactoring Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact friction point of Round 3 where teams must urgently adapt their initial solutions to unpredictable rule changes or feature requirements.

ideas.pitch: A strategic bidding dashboard that calculates optimal point expenditures and card combinations during the Power Card Auction round to maximize final scores.
ideas.problem_statement: PITCH//BREAK: THE SURVIVAL ARENA Round 2: Power Card Auction — Bid with your existing points to acquire Power Cards. Choose carefully: the right card could change your game.
ideas.title: BidStrat: Game-Theoretic Auction Optimizer for Power Cards
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a tactical gameplay advantage in Round 2, ensuring teams manage their points mathematically rather than emotionally under tournament pressure.

ideas.pitch: A sparring partner chatbot trained to ruthlessly cross-examine your project pitch, predict opponent counter-attacks, and generate defensive talking points.
ideas.problem_statement: PITCH//BREAK: THE SURVIVAL ARENA Final Round: Team vs Team — Surviving teams are paired to challenge each other’s solutions and pitches. Use any Power Cards you have.
ideas.title: DefendAI: Interactive Adversarial Debate Simulator for Team vs Team Face-offs
ideas.why_it_could_win: Prepares teams specifically for the Final Round face-offs by stress-testing their pitches against simulated adversarial attacks before stepping into the arena.

ideas.pitch: A transparent tracking dashboard that monitors point gains, power card inventories, and penalty deductions in real time across dynamic arena rounds.
ideas.problem_statement: PITCH//BREAK: THE SURVIVAL ARENA Every decision matters: earn points through your performance, use Power Cards strategically, and avoid faults that cost you points.
ideas.title: ArenaLedger: Real-Time Scoring & Fault Tracking System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases exceptional full-stack reliability and live telemetry, giving judges an unambiguous, working demo of tournament metrics.
